question: Which of the following ships was launched on 14 December 2020 in Kolkata?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Himgiri**__.

__
 
• **INS Himgiri **____**was launched on 14 December 2020 in Kolkata**__.​

 __
 
• INS Himgiri is the second ship of the Nilgiri class stealth-guided missile frigates being built for the Indian Navy by Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers.
 
• The ship was laid down on 10 November 2018 and was launched on 14 December 2020.
 
• The ship is expected to be commissioned by August 2023.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **INS Kolkata **is the leadership of the Kolkata-class stealth guided-missile destroyers of the Indian Navy.

 
 
• It was constructed at Mazagon Dock Limited.
 
 
 
• **INS Jalashwa** is an amphibious transport dock in service with the Indian Navy.
 
• **INS Shardul** is the lead ship of the Shardul-class amphibious warfare vessels of the Indian Navy.
 
 
• It was built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers.
